# Release notes 2.3

Version 2.3 fixes the export bug that cut off the last row of a CSV file. We found it when a customer sent us a file with 4,812 lines and only 4,811 came back.

The import screen is faster too. A 50 MB file now loads in about six seconds, down from forty. If your own files are larger and still slow, send one to support and we will look at it this week.
